questions.text: Which fairy-tale character left a glass slipper behind at the ball?
questions.explanation: Cinderella lost her slipper while fleeing at midnight.

questions.text: How many bears did Goldilocks meet?
questions.explanation: The story features Father, Mother and Baby Bear.

questions.text: Which wooden puppet's nose grows when he tells lies?
questions.explanation: Pinocchio was created by Carlo Collodi.

questions.text: In "Jack and the Beanstalk", what does Jack trade for the magic beans?
questions.explanation: Jack sells the family cow for the beans.

questions.text: Which French author published "Puss in Boots" and "Cinderella" in 1697?
questions.explanation: Perrault's Tales of Mother Goose appeared in 1697.

questions.text: In Norse mythology, which god wields the hammer Mjolnir?
questions.explanation: Thor, god of thunder, carries Mjolnir.

questions.text: In Greek myth, which winged horse sprang from Medusa's blood?
questions.explanation: Pegasus was born when Perseus slew Medusa.

questions.text: Which English folk hero is said to have lived in Sherwood Forest?
questions.explanation: Robin Hood is linked to Nottinghamshire's Sherwood Forest.

questions.text: In "Rumpelstiltskin", what does the imp spin from straw?
questions.explanation: The imp spins straw into gold for the miller's daughter.

questions.text: In Slavic folklore, which witch lives in a hut standing on chicken legs?
questions.explanation: Baba Yaga's hut on fowl's legs is a famous Russian image.

questions.text: Which legendary Rhine maiden is said to lure sailors onto the rocks with her song?
questions.explanation: The Lorelei legend is tied to a rock near Sankt Goarshausen.

questions.text: Which Irish folklore giant is said to have built the Giant's Causeway?
questions.explanation: Legend says Finn McCool built the causeway to reach Scotland.

questions.text: Which Finnish national epic did Elias Lonnrot compile in 1835?
questions.explanation: Lonnrot assembled the Kalevala from oral folk poetry.

questions.text: Which Mesopotamian epic hero seeks immortality after his friend Enkidu dies?
questions.explanation: The Epic of Gilgamesh is among the oldest surviving literary works.

spares.text: Which fairy-tale princess falls asleep after pricking her finger on a spindle?
spares.explanation: The curse forces Sleeping Beauty into a hundred-year sleep.

spares.text: In Greek myth, who was condemned to roll a boulder uphill forever?
spares.explanation: Sisyphus's boulder always rolled back down.

spares.text: In Japanese folklore, what is a kitsune?
spares.explanation: Kitsune are intelligent fox spirits with magical abilities.
